precepts.text: The well-favoured harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms and families through her witchcrafts. They sold us, which is how we got here. If you are down with America you are down with the devil.
precepts.point: Stumble not at the beauty of a woman, and desire her not for pleasure. Many of you see America as a gorgeous woman and are mesmerized; every pleasure is available in her. Many brothers fall by harlots, and you do not have to pick up a prostitute to be dealing with the mother of all harlots.
precepts.why:
Sirach warns not to stumble at the beauty of a woman, and the Lord calls this nation a harlot. Nahum says: “Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts.” The well-favoured harlot: some of you are caught up with her. I hope it isn’t a lot of you.

“That selleth nations through her whoredoms.” She sells nations. They sold us; that is how we got over here. “And families through her witchcrafts.”

Meaning what? If you are down with America, you are down with the devil. That is what the Bible is telling us. Nahum saw the same thing John the Revelator saw: the judgment of the great harlot that sits upon many waters, and upon her forehead “MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.” An abomination is something the Lord hates and despises.

So her beauty is the beauty of a harlot and a witch that sold us. Desire her not for pleasure.

precepts.text: Woe to the bloody city: America spilled the blood of Gad, Reuben, and Issachar to steal this country and built churches, courthouses, and schools on it. Full of lies and robbery; the prey departeth not; the noise of the whip, the rattling wheels, the prancing horses, and the jumping chariots move through time from stagecoaches to helicopters; a multitude of slain and none end of their corpses. Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, everybody wants to live in America and kisses the ground, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations, the two kingdoms of Judah and Ephraim, and families through her witchcrafts.
precepts.point: 1 Corinthians 1:21-29: it pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe; that is how we get out, not by fighting the pyramid. Not many wise, mighty, or noble are called; God hath chosen the foolish, the weak, the base, and the despised, the nation not desired, and things which are not, to bring to nought things that are, that no flesh should glory in his presence. Ephesians 1:4-5: chosen in him before the foundation of the world and predestinated unto the adoption of children. We did nothing magnanimous; he chose us to wake up in these last days.
precepts.why:
Christ said the gates of hell shall not prevail against his church. They tried when they murdered Nat Turner and the other men who knew they were Israelites, and through whispers and hushes the word kept going. “For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.” Sometimes our carnal mind says, if we organize we can overthrow the system. No. The governments of this earth are set up by Satan and God allows it; the Most High “setteth up over it the basest of men.” Only God can bring that pyramid down. We get out by “the foolishness of preaching”.

Nahum shows what we wrestle: “Woe to the bloody city! it is all full of lies and robbery; the prey departeth not”. America is the bloody city. She spilled the blood of the tribes of Gad, Reuben and Issachar to steal this country, and on the blood of our brothers and sisters she set up churches, courthouses and school institutions to indoctrinate us. This country is full of lies and robbery.

“The noise of a whip, and the noise of the rattling of the wheels, and of the pransing horses, and of the jumping chariots.” It moves up in time: the whip on the horse, the rattling wheels of the stagecoaches, and the jumping chariots, which are the helicopters. “and there is a multitude of slain, and a great number of carcases; and there is none end of their corpses”: they were slaughtering us.

“Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts”. America is the well-favoured harlot: everybody wants to live in America, and some kissed the ground when they got here and never saw any golden streets. She is the mistress of witchcrafts, and that is the gates of hell. “that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts”: the nations she sold were the two kingdoms of Judah and Ephraim. That is the spiritual wickedness in high places, and it shall not prevail.

precepts.text: The well-favoured harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms.
precepts.point: Thou hast said, none seeth me; thy wisdom and thy knowledge hath perverted thee. Desolation shall come suddenly.
precepts.why:
“Therefore hear now this, thou that art given to pleasures, that dwellest carelessly.” Given to pleasures: Lifestyles of the Rich and Famous, champagne wishes and caviar dreams, and it made negroes jealous and envious. “that sayest in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me.” Only the Most High can say I am; they are setting themselves up as God on earth. “I shall not sit as a widow”: I will always have my allies. “neither shall I know the loss of children”: my citizens will not die. “But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood”: their citizens put to death, and their allies cutting them loose, “for the multitude of thy sorceries.” Their science and technology, like the mystery weapon that left Venezuelan soldiers bleeding through the nose, God calls witchcraft.

Nahum names her: “Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.” The well-favoured harlot is the same whore of Revelation 17, America, the same virgin daughter of Babylon. She is well-favoured because this is Babylon the great: everybody wants to come here; everybody says, I can get rich there.

She is called the mistress of witchcrafts. And in case you did not think it was America: “that selleth nations.” What nations did America sell? The nation of Judah and the nation of Israel, the two kingdoms, sold into slavery. “and families through her witchcrafts”: did they not sell our families? You had better believe they did.

So the one given to pleasures who says I am, and none else beside me, is the harlot of Nahum. Her sorceries, labored in “from thy youth” since July 4th, 1776, are the reason the loss of children and widowhood will come upon her in one day.

precepts.text: I will shew the nations thy nakedness, and the kingdoms thy shame.
precepts.point: Thou hast trusted in thy wickedness and said, none seeth me; evil shall come upon thee, and thou shalt not know from whence it riseth.
precepts.why:
“Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne.” That is Esau: no more throne, no more power. She calls herself a virgin, and Nahum shows what she really is.

“Woe to the bloody city! it is all full of lies and robbery.” This is the bloody city right here. America is full of lies and robbery: they rob all the nations, and everything that comes out of their mouth is a lie. “Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.” America is that harlot. She destroys families and destroys nations and calls it democracy, bringing freedom, yet does not follow it herself. She sanctions the International Court of Justice when it brings charges against Netanyahu; that court was made to judge the black nations. The white man is above the law.

“Behold, I am against thee, saith the Lord of hosts; and I will discover thy skirts upon thy face.” God is against this place. He is going to discover America’s skirts and reveal her wickedness: America is not a virgin, she is a hoe who has been sleeping with everybody. “and I will shew the nations thy nakedness, and the kingdoms thy shame.” He is going to show the whole world how evil this place is.

For centuries they murdered, killed and robbed with no cameras, and said, “None seeth me.” Now social media records it and people see the evil in Venezuela, and still they look at the camera and say that is not what happened. The virgin daughter of Babylon who says none seeth me will have her nakedness uncovered before the nations, and through that, our deliverance and our salvation are coming.

precepts.text: The prey departed not; in captivity the people wax old in mind and will not leave.
precepts.point: In captivity the people wax old in mind and will not depart: woe to the bloody city, the prey departed not. Israel was the prey in Egypt and did not want to leave, the same as now.

note.label: Exodus 14: The Salvation of the Lord at the Red Sea

precepts.why:
“Woe to the bloody city! it is all full of lies and robbery; the prey departeth not”. In captivity the people wax old in mind and will not depart. Israel was the prey in Egypt, and the prey did not want to leave: “Let us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians”. Even out of Egypt, at the first sight of Pharaoh they wanted back.

It is the same now. The people sit in a bloody city full of lies and robbery, and the prey departeth not; they say let us alone to serve the slave master, because serving him feels easier than having faith in the Most High.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 18: Babylon Is Fallen

precepts.why: A precept for her sorceries. “Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot”: the whore that sat upon the beast with seven heads and ten horns, Babylon; well favoured, because everybody wants to come to America. “The mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts”: didn’t we just read in Revelation 18 that she sells slaves and souls of men? Not only the nations are under her spell; our people are under a spell as well.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 15 The Seven Last Plagues

precepts.why: “The wellfavoured harlot”: that’s Babylon the great. “The mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms”: that lets you know it is what we just read about. I’m not talking about voodoo; how does the white man put people under a spell so everybody says the same thing, like color doesn’t matter?

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 15 The Seven Last Plagues

precepts.why: “Thou hast multiplied thy merchants above the stars of heaven”: that’s all about the corporations, the companies.

precepts.why:
This is talking about Nineveh in the first, literal sense, but it is also a metaphor for America. “Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot”: the wellfavoured harlot is the United States of America, the mother of harlots of Revelation 17:5. Everybody loves that hoe called America.

“The mistress of witchcrafts”: Haiti thought they got witchcraft; America says you ain’t got nothing on us, we are the mistress of witchcrafts. “That selleth nations through her whoredoms”: we have been sold. All twelve tribes have been sold into slavery. “And families through her witchcrafts.” That is the seat of Satan these last days, and Pergamos dwelt where Satan’s seat is.
